metadata.title: Evaluate to true if the macos-def:authorizaiondb_test is properly supported
metadata.description: This definition is intended to evalutate to true if the interpreter properly supports the macos-def:authorizaiondb_test.

notes.note: It is important to note that the values used in this test definition are specific to a particular machine, and may not necessarily apply to your system. As a result, in order to have the definition return a result of 'true', you must either change these values to the ones found on your particular system, or you must configure your system to use these values.

criterion.comment: Test that the accountinfo_object is supported with the right_name entity equal to some value.
Test that the accountinfo_object is supported with the right_name entity matches a regular expression.
